_comment: Reference copy of the task role's permissions, for readers adapting the pattern outside the CDK. The CDK in stack.ts grants the equivalent access with grant* methods plus an inline Bedrock statement, so you do not need to attach this file when deploying with the CDK. Replace every <PLACEHOLDER> before use.

Statement._comment: The wildcard Region is deliberate. Cross-Region inference profiles can route a request to a Region other than the one called, so a Region-pinned ARN produces intermittent access-denied errors that are hard to diagnose because most requests still succeed. The two read actions let the CLI resolve an inference profile to its backing foundation model; without them it falls back to an alternate request shape that works but adds a round-trip.
